notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Myr Battlesphere.
Both Myr Battlespheres enter the battlefield, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.
